segments.title: Owls turn their heads 270°
segments.sub: Without **cutting off the blood** to their brain
segments.say: Owls can turn their heads two hundred seventy degrees, and their brain still gets blood.

segments.title: Humans? Arteries can TEAR
segments.sub: Sudden neck twists can **damage blood vessels**
segments.say: In people, sudden twists of the neck can stretch and tear blood vessels.

segments.title: Owls have 3 TRICKS
segments.say: Johns Hopkins scientists found three tricks. Wide holes in the neck bones. Blood pools under the jaw. And backup blood paths.
bullets: Wide holes in the neck bones

segments.title: 270° in EITHER direction
segments.say: That's up to two hundred seventy degrees, in either direction.
